empty.description: Include empty caches for Cache.list() and null values for cache.entries().

disabled.description: Include disabled caches (i.e., caches with enabled=false). By default, disabled caches are excluded.

memory.description: Include memory size in API results. This is an expensive operation for large caches.

limit.description: Limit the number of items returned: caches for Cache.list() and entries for Cache.entries().

valueSize.description:
Only used by Cache.entries() API. Determines how much data to return for the cache values.
Defaults to 250 characters.

sortBySize.description: Sort the results by size (memory if known, number of keys otherwise), then by name. Otherwise always sort by name.
